description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects traversal markers after the FortiWeb administrative API prefix.
affected_versions: Fortinet FortiWeb: 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, 7.6.0 through 7.6.4, 7.4.0 through 7.4.9, 7.2.0 through 7.2.11, 7.0.0 through 7.0.11; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects traversal markers after the FortiWeb administrative API prefix.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Traversal-like literal administrative path names are denied.
